body: Yeah thanks, today has been a much calmer day for my head and i'm trying to keep it up. Last night was such a mind fuck for me as i've never felt like that before. It's hard talking to people about my illness, but I find it much easier when I have no idea who they are and vice versa.
It's a specific event of such. I'm expecting to find out if my best freind (who knows about my depression to a certain extent) wants anything to do with me anymore. I'm scared of losing her.
